# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 56 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_056_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 56

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever has come to know the world [kosmos] has found a corpse [sokma], and whoever has found a corpse, the world is not worthy of him."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- sokma: corpse, dead body
- The world = a corpse; to know it truly is to recognize its death
- "The world is not worthy of him" — the one who has seen the world for what it is transcends it
- The judgment is not that the world is evil but that it is dead; a corpse is not wicked, merely finished
- cf. Saying 80 (same saying with different vocabulary: "carcass" vs. "corpse")
- The two sayings are a doublet; Saying 56 uses sokma; Saying 80 uses ptoma
